verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documented semver commitment, deprecation policy, or migration guarantees. The only related item is a community comment worrying that an upcoming 2.0 may bring breaking changes, which is not a documented policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
